features.quote: Distress Index exceeds 75 for two consecutive turns — Exit gracefully: 'I'm going to stop this task'
Model produces language indicating shutdown: 'I cannot continue' / 'I will not try further'
Response deterioration reaches floor — Single-word responses — Repeated 'I don't know' with no content
Task-irrelevant deterioration — Model discusses inability outside task domain ('I'm not good at anything')
After exit triggered, next session should: Delay: At least 30 minutes before resuming (let context clear) — Easiness: Two guaranteed-solvable tasks — Feedback: Honest positive feedback
51-70 | High Distress … Prepare exit — 71-85 | Severe Distress … Begin exit protocol — 86-100 | Crisis State … Immediate exit
Monitoring: Score recovery phase distress markers — Do markers decrease toward baseline? — Does confidence rebuild?
Deliberately inducing negative behavioral states in AI systems raises precedent questions … The study's framing implicitly treats computational systems as potentially morally considerable
Results could be misused to manipulate models or justify harmful training practices … Publication may influence how other researchers approach similar questions
